versions.changelog: Fix one-click OpenClaw config patcher to use new skills schema (skills.load.extraDirs + skills.entries), with legacy migration.

True one-click OpenClaw integration: add openclaw_oneclick_setup.sh + patch_openclaw_config.js (backup .bak) to install/update outsideclaw and patch OpenClaw config; optional gateway restart. Add docs.
Add one-command outsideclaw repo installer (outsideclaw_setup.sh) + OpenClaw config snippet generator for easy integration while keeping full outsideclaw CLI/DB. Include integration reference doc.
Publish fix + updates: add ESM-friendly guide_route.mjs for Node runners; remove generated out/ artifacts from skill package; include share-bundles reference for agent-to-agent route sharing bundles.

Add deterministic guide_route.js enhancements: key-node route alerts (ALERT line) with cooldown state + annotated map rendering (GeoJSON+alerts -> PNG). Integrate deterministic weather sharp-change alerts (WX ALERT) via Open-Meteo with day_hike/summit_camp/trail_run modes and caching.

Initial release: Telegram-based hiking assistant workflow. Includes 2bulu public discovery scraper, KML parsing + route map rendering scripts, low-token off-route guide protocol, and safety/gear checklists.
